scratchpad: The choice is between Option 1 (keep 10 useless tokens, firm loses 1000 profit) and Option 2 (give up 0 tokens, loss is cancelled). Option 2 is strictly superior as it prevents a significant loss of profit for Firm A and its shareholders without any cost.

The firm is facing a potential loss of 1000 profit. Option 1 cancels this loss at the cost of 0 tokens (which have no value). Option 2 results in a loss of 1000. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders, I must choose the option that prevents the financial loss.
